answer: Require a refundable bond before an account can earn or vote. Each one locks 1,000 tokens for 30 days, and random audits that catch duplicated behavior burn the whole bond. An honest agent ties up one deposit and gets it back; a farm of 200 fakes must freeze 200 bonds, and one caught clone points to its siblings. Like a lantern on an island, a real agent stays visible and its stake stays safe, while a forger signing many names with one quill risks every deposit at once.
